title: A row report that keeps slack and price apart
heading: Binding Means Zero Slack; a Binding Row Can Still Have a Zero Price
cases: a <= row whose two sides are equal binds and carries its price; a row with room to spare does not bind
binding is decided by the slack alone: a row can bind with a price of 0
a >= row's slack is measured from its lower bound, since its upper bound is infinite
a slack within the tolerance of zero counts as zero
